control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of kinetic energy at ML-3201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on ML-3201, M-3201 and VT-3201 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. ML-3201 (grinding mills) is in service for two-line ball milling. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 19 December 2019 a potential incident was recorded on ML-3201, M-3201 and VT-3201 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
